entities.name: Sargramostim
observations: Recombinant GM-CSF (Leukine); used to support myeloid recovery, including HIV-associated treatment-related neutropenia.
Acute systemic adverse reaction can include dyspnea, myalgia, vomiting, tachycardia, and hypotension shortly after administration.

entities.name: Acute sargramostim reaction
observations: The immediate combination of respiratory symptoms, myalgia, vomiting, tachycardia, and hypotension after a first dose is consistent with an acute systemic reaction to sargramostim.
